limitations: This is reference-harness evidence, not provider conformance or certification evidence.
The exact standard pin is commit d9a9d9f2a537c13648b79a0d47da03cf391ca314; the reference runner bytes are bound separately.

All three executions used the official Node.js v24.20.0 distribution; macOS archive SHA-256 was 40e5607e5ecb3db9192723776da2d75d966260fc74a7a9e731c1bd67dda96bc8 and Windows archive SHA-256 was 6cac9ffbca8f6a47091e4b5c772e0606049c3871cb67d900c0cedde630e545ba, each checked against Node.js SHASUMS256.txt.

The synthetic package resolver and CommonJS transformer establish the draft contract and negative boundaries; they are not a production npm client or a claim that any provider packager implements them.
The 16-package and 1,048,576-octet result proves local reference portability only; Cloudflare, EdgeOne, and Deislet live build and runtime limits remain pending.
No private registry credential or provider account was used; authentication redaction and package-cache isolation still require end-to-end fault injection.
The selected Node exports were executed in the reference runtime, but upstream Node test-suite coverage and three provider runtime executions remain release blockers.
